'''Big Wolves''' are level 20 [[wolf]] pack leaders. A lone Big Wolf is found on the [[White Wolf Mountain]] near the [[gnome glider]]. Other Big Wolves can be found in the [[Chaos Tunnels]].

== Trivia ==

* Big Wolves used to be aggressive before they were made unaggressive at an unknown date for reasons unknown.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament & Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (24 July 2017)|date=24 July 2017}}
** The big wolf on White Wolf Mountain no longer spawns inside a tree.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=A Shadow over Ashdale|date=22 April 2014}}
** The animations used on white wolves have been improved.
** The white variant was graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Chaos Tunnels, Interface Improvements, Extra Bank Space and More!|date=15 January 2008}}
** The grey variant has become available with the [[Chaos Tunnels]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Hair of the dog|date=4 June 2007}}
** The NPC was graphically updated.
** The grey variant was added to the cache, but was unused.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002)|date=27 February 2002}}
** Added to game.
